product.name: Lenovo L20M4P72 Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 2
product.description: Replacement battery (Model L20M4P72, FRU 5B10W51814, ASM SB10W51915) for the Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 2 — the strongest confirmed application for this battery. Also cross-compatible with L20L4P72, L20C4P72, L20D4P72, SB10W51914 and SB10W51916. 4-cell, 57Wh typical / 55Wh rated, 15.36V Li-Ion, manufactured by Simplo Technology. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
